'''Imbued wight footsoldiers''' are monsters fought in [[Sliske's Endgame]]. They are summoned by [[Sliske]] in the middle of the first wave of the combat section at the end of the quest. They are stronger than the [[Wight footsoldier (Sliske's Endgame)|wight footsoldiers]] but weaker than the [[unstable wight footsoldier]]s.
